title: MOPGA 2027: Visiting Fellowship Program for Early Career Researchers
official_source: Campus France, funded by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (MEAE) in partnership with the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Space (MESRE)
description: MOPGA is a French Government visiting fellowship that pays a monthly allowance to early-career foreign researchers to carry out a 12-month research project in a French host laboratory on climate and environmental themes. Each fellowship covers a monthly allowance of EUR 2,500, a EUR 500 settling-in allowance, and health, civil liability and repatriation coverage. Host laboratories receive no funding under the programme; the money is intended solely to cover the invited researcher's living expenses, and international travel costs are not covered.

title: AAPG - Appel à projets générique 2027 (ANR Generic Call for Proposals 2027)
duration: Project duration set by the applicant; grants are awarded annually across the project period
description: Principal call of the Agence nationale de la recherche, the Appel a projets generique 2027 is addressed to all scientific communities and all public or private actors involved in French research. It supports project-based research in all scientific domains and disciplines, giving full place to fundamental, exploratory or finalised research in an approach guided by researchers' curiosity, and mobilises five funding instruments from single-team to international collaboration.

title: PhD Position F/M Spatio-temporal analysis of remote sensing data at large scales (Inria offer 2026-10352)
official_source: Inria (Centre Inria d'Universite Cote d'Azur, TITANE team)
description: Inria, the French national institute for research in digital science and technology, recruits PhD students as fixed-term salaried employment contracts rather than as scholarship holders. This post is a 3-year doctoral contract at the Centre Inria d'Universite Cote d'Azur (team TITANE, Sophia Antipolis) with a published gross monthly salary of EUR 2,300, starting 1 December 2026. The work sits inside the JUNN Digital Twin of France and its Territories project, on detecting and analysing 3D change from airborne LidarHD and satellite Digital Surface Model data at national scale.

title: Institut Pascal (IPa) Call for Proposals 2026
duration: Programmes typically run 2-3 weeks, up to 6 weeks
description: Institut Pascal is a Université Paris-Saclay institute that runs thematic scientific programmes lasting typically 2-3 weeks and up to 6 weeks, hosting up to 60 international and national visitors. Selected programmes receive funding for accommodation, on-site catering and part of travel costs for the visiting scientists and students, plus meeting rooms and 26 offices in the Orsay facility. Applications are made by programme organisers as a single PDF, not by individual students.

title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship for Research in Japan (Standard Program)
official_source: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS), Overseas Fellowship Division, International Program Department
description: JSPS funds postdoctoral researchers from overseas to conduct collaborative research in Japan under the guidance of a Japanese host researcher at a university or other eligible research institution. Financial support is a maintenance allowance of JPY362,000 per month, a round-trip air ticket, a settling-in allowance of JPY200,000, and overseas travel insurance. A Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research for JSPS Research Fellows can also be applied for through the host institution to cover cooperative research-related expenses. title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship for Research in Japan (Short-term Program for North American and European Researchers, PE)
official_source: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS), Overseas Fellowship Division, International Program Department
description: This programme brings PhD students and PhD researchers from North America and Europe to Japan to conduct collaborative research under the guidance of a Japanese host for between one and twelve months. Financial support is a maintenance allowance of JPY362,000 per month for PhD holders or JPY200,000 per month for non-PhD holders at the start of the research in Japan, a round-trip air ticket, a settling-in allowance of JPY200,000 for fellows with three or more months of tenure, and overseas travel insurance. title: Apoyo Complementario SECIHTI-OEA 2026
official_source: Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación (Secihti) and Organización de los Estados Americanos (OAS)
duration: The support itself is a one-off contribution for settling-in expenses; the underlying Secihti scholarship runs for the postgraduate programme.
description: A complementary support awarded jointly by the OAS and Mexico's Secihti to students who already hold a Secihti National Scholarship for a full-time postgraduate programme in Mexico. The OAS contribution is a single payment of USD 1,200 for settling-in expenses in Mexico, paid in Mexican pesos at the official exchange rate on the day OAS deposits it, and the number of supports depends on OAS funds. Secihti adds its monthly support under the Secihti 2026 National Scholarship Scale plus ISSSTE medical service.
